decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a low-cost consumable that fits the core thermoforming range and are cheap to keep in the catalog, though they have gone unobserved on the website since 2018.
PETG blanks are a staple thermoforming material with steady repeat demand from dental labs and aligner-related workflows.
The UV-curing lacquer has low visibility and may be a candidate for portfolio cleanup, but its stocking cost is minimal and it supports lab finishing.
The intraoral contrast spray supports the firm's push into digital scanning workflows, which keeps it strategically relevant.
